attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as authoritative DNS resolver for node2/node3: added an Unbound DNSBL wildcard blocklist entry for `blocked.example` returning NXDOMAIN (blocking the domain and all subdomains), applied via configctl template reload + unbound dnsbl, pointed node2/node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1's LAN IP (10.100.155.10), and verified normal resolution continues to work for all other domains. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and post-restart recovery of both the DNS service and the persisted blocking config.
